intent: Tags the person types. Enter or a delimiter adds one. Optional suggestions.
useWhen: Free-form labels such as keywords the person creates
A short list of suggestions while they type, without a fixed option set
doNotUseWhen: Choosing from a fixed list — use MultiSelect
One value from a list — use Combobox or Select

suggestions.note: Shown while typing. Picking one adds a tag.

delimiters.note: Single-character keys that commit a tag, besides Enter.

requirements: Input is role=combobox when suggestions are open
Enter or a delimiter adds the typed text. Arrow keys move through suggestions
Backspace on an empty query removes the last tag
Duplicate tags, compared case-insensitively, are ignored
Escape closes suggestions. Each tag remove button removes that tag
Must have a Field label or ariaLabel

doNot: Do not use TagInput to choose from a required option list — use MultiSelect
Do not invent a local chip — tags are kit Tag
snippet: <Field label="Keywords" htmlFor="keywords"><TagInput id="keywords" placeholder="Add a keyword" suggestions={keywords} /></Field>
